items.author: Dante Alighieri
items.rights: Public-domain original; IT/EN editorial rendering where translated.

it.text: Considerate la vostra semenza: fatti non foste a viver come bruti, ma per seguir virtute e canoscenza.
it.lead: Considerate la vostra semenza: fatti non foste a viver come bruti,
it.ending: ma per seguir virtute e canoscenza.

en.text: Consider your origin: you were not made to live like brutes, but to pursue virtue and knowledge.
en.lead: Consider your origin: you were not made to live like brutes,
en.ending: but to pursue virtue and knowledge.
